# SSection `<s-section>`

Groups related content, with an optional heading, subheading and actions. `SSection` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-section>` web component.

```ts
import { SSection } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Group content that belongs together.** Give every section a single, coherent job, whether that's related information or related controls; it then works as a visual container and adds meaning to the page structure.
- **Write descriptive headings.** Merchants skim the `heading` to find their way, so state what's inside rather than falling back on a generic title.
- **Nest only as deep as the content needs.** A nested section affects the heading hierarchy and the outline of the page rather than how it looks. Keep it to two or three levels at most, and nest only when the extra structure makes the content clearer.
- **Drop the padding when content should span edge to edge.** Use `padding="none"` for things like tables or images that ought to fill the section, then check that the inner content keeps enough spacing of its own.
- **Add an `accessibilityLabel` when the heading isn't enough.** When the on-screen heading leaves the section's purpose unclear for people using screen readers, give them a label that fills in the missing context.
- **Pick the right header slot.** Put details that modify the heading itself, like a tooltip or a count, in `accessory`. Put information about the section as a whole, like a status badge, in `supplemental`. Actions such as a button or menu belong in `accessory`, since `supplemental` doesn't take them.

```vue
<SSection heading="Products" padding="none">
  <STable>
    <!-- … -->
  </STable>
</SSection>
```

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-section>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/layout-and-structure/section#best-practices) for the full guidance.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | A label that describes the purpose or content of the component for assistive technologies like screen readers. Use this to provide additional context when the visible content alone doesn't clearly convey the component's purpose. |
| `heading` | `string` | The heading text displayed at the top of the section. This heading provides a title for the section's content and automatically uses the appropriate semantic heading level (h2, h3, h4) based on nesting depth to maintain proper document structure. |
| `padding` | `"base" \| "none"` | The padding applied to all edges of the element's content. - `base`: applies padding that is appropriate for the element. Note that it might result in no padding if this is the right design decision in a particular context. - `none`: removes all padding from the element's content. This can be useful when elements inside the section need to span to the edge of the section. For example, a full-width image. In this case, rely on `s-box` with a padding of 'base' to bring back the desired padding for the rest of the content. The `heading` and header actions keep their padding, so they can be combined with `none`. |
| `subheading` | `string` | Supporting text that expands on the heading, rendered beneath it in a subdued treatment. This is not a heading: it adds no entry to the document outline, doesn't change the heading level of the section's children, and isn't announced as part of the heading. Keep whatever distinguishes this section from another in `heading`, since that is what someone navigating by heading hears. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The content displayed within the section component, which groups related elements together in a logical unit with an optional heading. |
| `accessory` | Additional contextual information that qualifies the heading, rendered inline beside the heading text. Only accepts Badge, Icon, Button, Menu, Text, Avatar, Thumbnail, and Tooltip elements. Text must use `tone`, `fontSize`, and `fontWeight` of `auto`; Icon, Avatar, and Thumbnail must use `size="base"`; Badge must use `size="base"` and `color="base"`; Button must use `inlineSize="auto"`. A Tooltip an accessory element's `interestFor` points at can be slotted here beside it. |
| `graphic` | A decorative visual that reinforces the heading, rendered before it. Accepts a single Icon with a `size` of `base`, or an icon-only Badge (`icon` set, no text content) with a `size` of `large`. The heading identifies the section, so this content is not announced by assistive technologies, and it is not rendered at all when the section has no `heading`. |
| `primary-action` | The primary action button or link, representing the main or most important action available in this context. Typically displayed with higher visual prominence than secondary actions to establish clear hierarchy. |
| `secondary-actions` | Additional action buttons or links that provide alternative or supporting actions. Visually de-emphasized compared to the primary action. A ButtonGroup holding an action and the icon-only activator for its Menu renders as one segmented group with a chevron activator. The group needs an `accessibilityLabel`, and must hold exactly one Button with text followed by one Button with no text that has an `accessibilityLabel` and a `commandFor` opening a Menu, both with a `variant` of `secondary` or `auto`. |
| `supplemental` | Status or metadata that describes the section as a whole rather than qualifying its heading, rendered at the inline-end of the header before any actions. This is not an action. Only accepts Badge, Avatar, Text, Icon, Thumbnail, and Tooltip elements, under the same prop constraints as `accessory`. |
